page.content:
Devil-marked son who took the Zaibatsu, lost it, and returned through G Corporation.

How Kazuya Mishima connects

  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Heihachi threw Kazuya into a ravine and spent decades at war with him.
  • Concept: Devil Gene — Kazuya's Devil form is the first great expression of the Devil Gene.
  • Faction: G Corporation — Kazuya rebuilt his power as the hidden head of G Corporation.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin exists to end Kazuya — and the Mishima curse with him.
  • Work: Tekken 2 — Tekken 2 is the chapter in which Kazuya sits the Zaibatsu throne.
  • Work: Tekken 8 — Tekken 8 casts Kazuya's Devil as the world-ending threat.
  • Concept: Mishima-style karate — Kazuya's Mishima-style karate mirrors his father's, with Devil layered on.
  • Character: Jun Kazama — Jun tried to pull Kazuya back from the Devil Gene.

What is Kazuya Mishima?

Kazuya Mishima survived Heihachi's ravine, won the first King of Iron Fist Tournament, and later rebuilt power at G Corporation so he could finish the family war in Tekken 8.

Key threads lead to Heihachi Mishima, Devil Gene, G Corporation, Jin Kazama, Tekken 2 and Tekken 8.
